method: Deterministic MCP SDK calls to a disposable local fixture. No LLM agent was used.

fixture.task: Read a local form snapshot, fill Task label with synthetic-ok, click Save, then inspect the separate status output.
fixture.data: No remote site, user profile, account, CAPTCHA, or production data was used.

results.connection: --cdp-endpoint to a dedicated temporary Chrome process and profile
--browser-url to a dedicated temporary Chrome process and profile

limitations: One retained run per package is a local smoke check, not a speed, reliability, or general capability benchmark.
The test covers manual loopback HTTP CDP attachment. Chrome DevTools MCP autoConnect and its consent dialog were not tested.
Tool names and argument schemas can change; inspect the installed server's tools/list and current documentation.
